title: Success Stories
paragraphs: Tumbuh besar di ruang tunggu klinik kecil di lingkungannya, menyaksikan ibunya bekerja sebagai perawat, Idris memutuskan sejak usia muda bahwa ia ingin menjadi dokter dan mengabdi untuk komunitasnya suatu hari nanti. Jalannya tidak sederhana. Ia gagal dalam ujian masuk pertamanya dan menghabiskan satu tahun tambahan belajar secara mandiri, sering meragukan apakah kedokteran benar-benar pilihan yang tepat bagi seseorang dengan latar belakangnya.

Ibunya mendorongnya untuk terus mencoba, mengingatkan bahwa kesuksesan yang tertunda tetaplah kesuksesan, bukan kegagalan. Ia akhirnya lulus pada percobaan keduanya dan memulai sekolah kedokteran dua tahun lebih lambat dari rencana. Kini, sepuluh tahun kemudian, Idris menjalankan klinik kecil di lingkungan yang sama tempat ia tumbuh besar, merawat banyak keluarga yang dulu menyaksikannya tumbuh menjadi dokter yang selalu ingin ia capai.
answerKey: Growing up in a small neighborhood clinic's waiting room, watching his mother work as a nurse, Idris decided at a young age that he wanted to become a doctor and serve his community someday. The path was not simple. He failed his first entrance exam and spent an extra year studying independently, often doubting whether medicine was really the right choice for someone with his background. His mother encouraged him to keep trying, reminding him that a delayed success is still a success, not a failure. He eventually passed his second attempt and began medical school two years later than planned. Now, ten years later, Idris runs a small clinic in the same neighborhood where he grew up, treating many of the families who once watched him grow into the doctor he had always intended to become.
